new_platform_shipped_by_q3.note: Binary 'shipped' with no work-remaining quantity and no velocity-to-completion mapping. 'Q3' has no year or fiscal basis (today is 27 Sep 2026).

additional_delivery_capacity.note: FTE-equivalent capacity; natural effects 1.5 per senior and 0.75 per junior (olumi_estimate). No ramp-up timing.

annual_salary_spend.note: Options set it directly (£240k / £260k / £250k, cee_hypothesis). The placeholder natural effects (£100,000 per 2 seniors) contradict the option levels (INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY); the interventions override them.

additional_platform_delivery_velocity.note: Platform delivery units per month: a typed rate, but there is no stock of work remaining for it to deplete.

senior_hiring_lead_time.note: Lag concept named but not quantified (no months).

junior_ramp_up_time.note: Lag concept named but not quantified (no months).

goal_model_t2.note: No deadline and no quantified goal.

notes: Lead time and ramp-up are exactly the lags a dynamic engine would need, but they are named only as unquantified risks.
